ARISTOCRAT.title: The Aristocrat
ARISTOCRAT.unlockText: This character is unlocked by default.
ARISTOCRAT.description: A privileged heir who turns gold, shops, Strikes and Defends into an inevitable victory.
ARISTOCRAT.cardsModifierDescription: Aristocrat cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
ARISTOCRAT.eventDeathPrevention: My name does not permit me to fall here.
ARISTOCRAT.goldMonologue: [sine]This gold was always meant for better hands.[/sine]
